question: The Botanical Survey of India is located at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Botanical Survey of India (BSI) is headquartered in **Kolkata**.
 
• BSI was founded on **13 February 1890**, and it is an institution under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.
 
• The primary objectives of BSI are to explore plant resources of the country and to identify plant species with economic virtues.
